notes.title: The Fateweaver Series & How to become a character!
notes.content:
[b]Hello everyone!

We are running sales on ALL of our titles for the best deals to date!

We are also choosing new names from the comments on previous games to participate as characters in our new Series titled, "The Fateweaver Series" which you can find in the link below!

We've released  The Test: Secrets of the Soul for FREE, and we will be releasing Fateweaver: Episode 2 on April 10th, along with perhaps another surprise title... Stay tuned!


Thank you so much for your continued support! We appreciate you and hope you're having a wonderful day!

- Randumb Studios[/b]
